## Natural history notes

A small dark skipper characterized by brown wings with pale spots, a dusky mottled pattern, and a low, fast flight close to the ground. In Florida, Juvenal’s Duskywing is found in dry woodlands, oak scrub, sandhills, pine-oak woods, forest edges, roadsides, and sunny openings where oaks are present. Adults visit flowers and perch on bare ground or low vegetation, while the caterpillars feed on oak leaves and live concealed in leaf shelters made with silk.
